title: Comparing Uncertainty Measurement and Mitigation Methods for Large Language Models: A Systematic Review
abstract: arXiv:2504.18346v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been transformative across many domains. However, hallucination, i.e., confidently outputting incorrect information, remains one of the leading challenges for LLMs. This raises the question of how to accurately assess and quantify the uncertainty of LLMs. Extensive literature on traditional models has explored Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) to measure uncertainty and employed calibration techniques to address the misalignment between uncertainty and accuracy. While some of these methods have been adapted for LLMs, the literature lacks an in-depth analysis of their effectiveness and does not offer a comprehensive benchmark to enable insightful comparison among existing solutions. In this work, we fill this gap via a systematic survey of representative prior works on UQ and calibration for LLMs and introduce a rigorous benchmark. translated_title: 大型语言模型的不确定性测量与缓解方法比较：一项系统性综述
translated_abstract: arXiv:2504.18346v4 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：大型语言模型（LLMs）已在许多领域产生了变革性影响。然而，幻觉现象，即自信地输出错误信息，仍是LLMs面临的主要挑战之一。这引发了如何准确评估和量化LLMs不确定性的问题。关于传统模型的广泛文献已探索了不确定性量化（UQ）来测量不确定性，并采用校准技术来解决不确定性与准确性之间的错位问题。虽然其中一些方法已适用于LLMs，但现有文献缺乏对其有效性的深入分析，也未提供全面的基准来促进现有解决方案之间的有见地比较。在本工作中，我们通过系统调查LLMs中UQ和校准的代表性先前研究，并引入一个严格的基准来填补这一空白。利用三个广泛使用的可靠性数据集，我们进行了实证评估。
tldr: 本文通过系统性综述和严格基准测试，首次全面评估了大型语言模型中不确定性量化与校准方法的有效性，填补了该领域缺乏深入比较的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically reviews and benchmarks uncertainty quantification and calibration methods for LLMs, providing the first comprehensive evaluation of their effectiveness and filling the gap of lacking insightful comparisons.
